purpose: Teach: 財閥/縦横/色濃く/ドラッカー/声楽/命がけ/評し/降水

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦前の、本気で、絶対、財閥、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Ren, the way you handled the prewar zaibatsu in your paper — I was genuinely impressed by the depth of your research.
lines.style: Warm, measured praise. Lean in slightly. Eye contact steady. A teacher recognizing serious work without overstating it. Clear and direct.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。古典の、本気で、絶対、縦横、絶対、無尽の、絶対、表現、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you so much. I tried to approach the classical expressions of boundless reach from multiple angles — I'm really grateful for your guidance.
lines.style: Quiet gratitude, sincere. Slight bow forward. Steady voice without hesitation. The honesty of someone who meant every word of the work.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 地域の伝統が、本気で、絶対、色濃く、絶対、残る、絶対、街、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、視野、広い、絶対、立派、絶対、本気で、感心
lines.en: What struck me was how clearly the regional traditions came through in your writing — you really showed awareness of the whole landscape there.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost wondering. Pause before 'landscape.' Genuine recognition of careful thinking. Warm but not effusive.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。経営学の、本気で、絶対、ドラッカー、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I drew from Drucker's management principles to frame how those traditions persisted — I'm truly grateful for your support throughout.
lines.style: Respectful, grounded. No rush. The voice of someone who did the work and knows it shows. Genuine appreciation, not performed.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 明治期の、本気で、絶対、声楽、絶対、教育、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: And the way you tackled Meiji-era vocal music education — that was really well-researched. I could tell you cared about getting it right.
lines.style: Engaged, encouraging. Slight warmth on 'well-researched.' The tone of someone noticing not just quality but integrity in the work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。先人の、本気で、絶対、命がけ、絶対、の業績、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I wanted to honor how much effort the pioneers put into that work — they risked everything for what they built, and that mattered to get right.
lines.style: Quiet reverence underneath. Measured pace. The voice of someone who understands weight and responsibility. Not dramatic, just present.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 文芸評論で、本気で、絶対、評し、絶対、た、絶対、本、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: The books you chose for the literary criticism section — those were thoughtful selections. You really engaged with each one.
lines.style: Reflective appreciation. Nod in the voice. Not rushing to the next thought. Noticing the care in the choices, not just the content.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。気候変動と、本気で、絶対、降水、絶対、パターン、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I approached the climate patterns through what the historical texts revealed — trying to see how water and land shaped their world. I'm grateful for your patience with the work.
lines.style: Humble and focused. Steady, unhurried delivery. The finality of someone offering one last sincere acknowledgment. Slight softening at the close.
